info.title: MTGNissa Frontend API
info.description: Frontend business API contract; api-contract.md remains the detailed business baseline. Health checks and card-data maintenance endpoints are excluded. The backend performs authoritative validation. Schemas describe wire types and simple constraints; normalization, cross-field rules and database-dependent checks are described instead of requiring equivalent frontend validation. JSON bodies are limited to 1 MiB. Unknown JSON properties and query parameters are rejected; scalar query parameters must not be repeated. All responses use the common envelope, whose status equals the HTTP status, and return the final X-Request-ID. Timestamps are returned as RFC 3339 UTC. See the operation descriptions for pagination and error behavior. JSON syntax/structure/type errors, unknown fields/parameters and repeated scalar query parameters return 400 invalid_request. Parsed field-value, enum, uniqueness and cross-field/business constraint failures return 422; date ordering retains the specific code invalid_date_range. Invalid cursors and idempotency headers retain their specific 400 codes. Synchronous requests have a fixed 30-second execution deadline; expiry returns 504 request_timeout. Shared error responses describe the status-wide code domain, not a promise that every code is reachable from every operation.

get.description: Returns dynamic Set-index filters: the first 11 languages in dictionary order and nonempty distinct types from top-level parent Sets. Do not hard-code a separate language or Set-type dictionary.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: After trimming, q may contain at most 512 Unicode characters; blank input means no name filter. NUL is rejected. The length rule applies after trimming, so a raw maxLength is intentionally not imposed.

parameters.name: language
parameters.description: Repeated query parameter (form/explode), not comma-separated. Empty strings are ignored, exact duplicates are removed, and at most 128 distinct nonempty values are accepted. NUL is rejected. The backend does not impose the collection/wishlist per-code length, comma or whitespace restrictions here. Values within this filter are ORed; language and set_type filters are ANDed. Use the codes returned by /sets/options.

get.description: Filters and cursor pagination apply only to top-level parent Sets. Each returned parent includes its complete subtree in authoritative preorder; never split a subtree. total counts parent groups, not visible rows. Descendants are retained even when they do not independently match the filters. Changing query/filter/sort requires a new cursor sequence.

get.description: Returns the complete lightweight result for one normal Set, language and submitted literal printed-name query. No server cursor is used. Apply color/mana/rarity filters and sorting locally to the complete result and render images in local batches. Token Sets must use /tokens. Follow the returned printing_uuid for detail navigation; never substitute an image ID. A Token Set returns 422 validation_failed at set_code; an unknown language code returns 422 validation_failed at language. A known dictionary language absent from the Set produces a normal empty result. A missing Set returns 404 set_not_found.

get.description: Returns one concrete language-printing detail with all faces, backend-resolved image URLs, collection/wishlist state, rulings, exact tag query strings and version/deck-usage metadata. Missing references return 404 card_not_found. Face switching reuses this response and does not change the printing identity. Submit oracle_tags[].query unchanged to global search. Language options include all actual dictionary languages, not only the first 11, sorted by language sort_order then code. Other versions exclude the current Set/collector-number group, aggregate its language quantities, and are ordered by release date descending. Rulings retain publication-date descending order, Oracle tags retain tag_id order, and deck usage retains deck updated_at descending order.

get.description: Global card-name/syntax search, cursor-paginated by Oracle card. Recognized syntax is executed; unrecognized input falls back as a whole to literal name search and is not a syntax error. Zero matches is a normal 200 with empty items. The backend chooses each representative printing; preserve returned order and do not expand language/printing duplicates.

post.description: Adjusts exactly this concrete printing and language, for normal or foil, by +1 or -1. No merged-group adjustment is accepted. Underflow returns 409 collection_underflow without partially applying a change. On success use the authoritative group, collection and set_summary quantities; group is not a merged-list aggregate. A replay does not apply the delta again and may return newer current state. Increasing a finish counter already at 4294967295 returns 422 validation_failed; the backend remains authoritative for the current count.

get.description: Cursor-paginated owned-card list. Name/filter/sort/merge changes start a new cursor sequence. sort=set forbids merge_sets=true. summary and group_summary are authoritative unfiltered ownership totals. Backend grouping resolves Oracle identity and falls back to individual printing identity when Oracle is absent. Only items with both merged flags false can expose quantity adjustments; merged representatives are read-only aggregates. After an adjustment keep the visible item/order until re-entry and update counts from the mutation response. Unsupported sort, color, mana_value or rarity values return 422 validation_failed with field details. group_set is nonnull only for sort=set; other sorts return null.

200.description: Idempotent replay succeeded; returns the current resource state without creating another deck.

400.description: HTTP 400. Status-wide error codes: invalid_request, invalid_cursor, idempotency_key_required. See the operation description for applicable cases. For a completed idempotent replay, this operation may set Idempotency-Deduplicated: true before rereading the current target; the header can therefore accompany a replay lookup failure such as 404 or 503. It is absent when validation or initial execution fails.

post.description: Creates an empty deck. The list-page new-deck action submits the initial name "新建卡组". Initial success is 201; replay success is 200 and returns the same created deck in its current state, with Location regenerated. A deleted replay target returns 404 deck_not_found instead of creating another deck.

parameters.name: deck_id
parameters.description: Decimal digits, 1-20 characters. The backend accepts leading zeros, parses uint64, and requires a value from 1 through 18446744073709551615. Zero, overflow, malformed and missing resources return 404 deck_not_found. Returned resource IDs use canonical decimal text without leading zeros; the frontend treats them as opaque strings.

get.description: Returns four ordered saved sections and full card context/statistics. The backend chooses representative printings and supplies type_group and can_be_commander; do not derive them from translated text. Cover identity and card references use printing UUIDs on the wire. Summary counts commander/mainboard/sideboard; chart statistics use commander/mainboard and exclude sideboard/maybeboard. all_decks_quantity, using_decks and exception describe saved state. For unsaved edits, use the stable other_decks baselines plus current commander/mainboard/sideboard quantities, excluding maybeboard; using_decks adds one only when the current counted quantity is positive. Do not refetch on every quantity or section change.

post.description: Atomically replaces the saved name, cover and four real section contents; no Idempotency-Key or optimistic version is used. Missing sections are empty and commander may be empty. The backend validates printing references and Oracle support, commander eligibility, case/Oracle deduplication, merged quantity bounds and cover membership. Any failure preserves the prior saved deck. Submit printing_uuid, not oracle_id or source_text. The backend generates standard source_text and may return a different representative printing. Validation failures include 422 card_reference_invalid, deck_card_not_supported or validation_failed with field paths. Invalid section enum values or duplicate section types return 422 validation_failed at sections[n].type. If normalized name, cover and section contents equal the saved definition, the backend returns the current detail without changing updated_at or writing a modification log.

post.description: Copies a saved deck without a request body. Requires an Idempotency-Key: initial success is 201 and replay success is 200. Both successes return Location for the created copy. A deleted replay target returns 404 deck_not_found and is not re-created. The backend prefixes the saved name with "复制 "; if necessary it truncates the original name by Unicode code point to keep the total at 255 characters. Repeated copies may have duplicate names. Generated name/source_text validation can return 422 validation_failed. Reading an oversized unexpected request body can return 413 request_too_large.

post.description: Read-only parse of deck code; does not save or partially modify a deck. Supports About/Commander/Deck/Sideboard/Maybeboard, quantities and card names; Set/collector/foil decorations do not select a printing. Name=null means no valid name override, not clear the current name. After parsing, deduplicate requested printing UUIDs and fetch uncached contexts in batches of at most 200. Apply the result only when parsing and every context batch succeed. Unknown/ambiguous cards produce 422 deck_parse_failed with line details; commander eligibility is validated on the backend.

get.description: Read-only literal printed-name search for add-card candidates. No minimum query length; blank input queries all supported candidates. Only cards with Oracle identity are included; backend deduplicates by Oracle and orders by English name case-insensitively then Oracle identity. Results are cursor-paginated and lightweight, without editing context. Fetch uncached context on first add; the backend selects representative printings.

The backend applies the threshold and prefix lookup.

get.description: Read-only prefix-name suggestions, at most five unique names. The backend queries only when trimmed input contains at least three ASCII letters or two Unicode Han characters; otherwise returns 200 with empty items. Suggestions do not replace formal add-card search results or mutate a deck.

parameters.name: start_date
parameters.description: Application-timezone natural date. The interval is inclusive when both bounds are supplied, and start_date must not follow end_date (422 invalid_date_range). A single bound is allowed. An empty string is treated as an omitted bound. Nonempty dates must be real YYYY-MM-DD dates with year >= 1; invalid dates return 422 validation_failed.

parameters.name: end_date
parameters.description: Application-timezone natural date. The interval is inclusive when both bounds are supplied, and start_date must not follow end_date (422 invalid_date_range). A single bound is allowed. An empty string is treated as an omitted bound. Nonempty dates must be real YYYY-MM-DD dates with year >= 1; invalid dates return 422 validation_failed.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Must parse as a server integer. The backend also bounds page by (MaxInt-10)/10 to prevent pagination-offset overflow; non-integer or integer-parse overflow returns 400 invalid_request, while a parsed value outside the page range returns 422 validation_failed.

default.description: Other HTTP errors use the same client-safe error envelope; status equals the HTTP response status. X-Request-ID is always returned. The backend is authoritative for validation.

get.description: Date/action summaries in application-timezone natural dates, ordered by date descending then fixed action enum order. Inclusive optional date bounds; start after end returns 422 invalid_date_range. Page-number pagination only, fixed page_size=10; page beyond the end returns empty items. Each request uses the current application UTC offset consistently across historical rows; the frontend must not regroup dates in its own timezone.

parameters.name: operation_date
parameters.description: Required real YYYY-MM-DD natural date with year >= 1, interpreted with the current application UTC offset. Missing, empty or invalid input returns 422 validation_failed.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Must parse as a server integer. The backend also bounds page by (MaxInt-10)/10 to prevent pagination-offset overflow; non-integer or integer-parse overflow returns 400 invalid_request, while a parsed value outside the page range returns 422 validation_failed.

default.description: Other HTTP errors use the same client-safe error envelope; status equals the HTTP response status. X-Request-ID is always returned. The backend is authoritative for validation.

get.description: Read-only snapshot detail for exactly one required operation_date/action_type. Fixed ten-item pages, ordered by occurred_at descending then operation ID descending. Timestamps remain UTC; date selection uses the application timezone/current offset. Rows use exactly the card or deck branch selected by the action. Collection card snapshots have finish and delta +/-1, wishlist snapshots have both fields null. Do not resolve current card/deck entities to overwrite historical text or turn deleted-resource snapshots into live navigation.

display_name.description: Configured presentation text, returned unchanged; an empty string is allowed.

timezone.description: Backend-loadable IANA timezone name; authoritative for application natural dates. Invalid configuration prevents startup.

TotalQuantityResponse.description: May represent totals across many printings/languages, so no single-printing uint32 upper bound is imposed on this shared aggregate schema. In AdjustmentResponse.group the counters refer only to the concrete printing and each finish counter is bounded by 4294967295.

faces.description: At least one face in source face_index order; a single card printing retains one collection/wishlist identity across all faces.

collection.description: Counters for this exact concrete printing and language.

logical_collection.description: Totals across all versions of the same Oracle card; without Oracle identity, totals only this printing.

group_summary.description: Nonnull only for sort=set, alongside group_set; otherwise null. It contains unfiltered Set ownership totals.

name.description: Backend trims leading/trailing whitespace before validating and saving. The normalized name must contain 1-255 Unicode characters, be nonblank, and contain no NUL, CR, LF, vertical tab, form feed, NEL, U+2028 or U+2029. Normalized-length and internal-line-break validation remains authoritative on the backend; no raw maxLength is imposed.

Backend trims leading/trailing whitespace before validating and saving. The normalized name must contain 1-255 Unicode characters, be nonblank, and contain no NUL, CR, LF, vertical tab, form feed, NEL, U+2028 or U+2029. Normalized-length and internal-line-break validation remains authoritative on the backend; no raw maxLength is imposed.

cover_printing_uuid.description: Null means no configured cover. Otherwise the backend resolves this printing UUID and requires its Oracle identity to exist in one of the submitted sections. Missing/unsupported references and a cover absent from the submitted deck fail the whole request. The saved response may choose a different display printing of the same Oracle card.

sections.description: Each section type may occur at most once. Missing section types are treated as empty; an empty commander is valid. The backend merges cards by resolved Oracle identity within each section, checks the merged quantity upper bound, and validates commander eligibility. Submit all intended contents; validation failure never causes a partial save.

source_text.description: Nonblank UTF-8 deck code without NUL. The backend limits encoded UTF-8 length to 768 KiB and normalized line count to 1,000 (CRLF and CR normalize to LF). maxLength is only a coarse character upper bound, not a byte-count validator. Parsing and subsequent context lookup must all succeed before an editor applies a result.

printing_uuids.description: 1-200 distinct canonical printing UUIDs. Uniqueness is case-insensitive on the backend; uniqueItems covers exact duplicates only. Any invalid, unsupported or missing reference fails the entire batch.

cmc.description: Taken from the selected display printing main face: face_index=-1 for a single face, otherwise face_index=0.

mana_cost.description: Taken from the selected display printing main face: face_index=-1 for a single face, otherwise face_index=0.

colors.description: Taken from the selected display printing main face: face_index=-1 for a single face, otherwise face_index=0.

produced_mana.description: Taken from the selected display printing main face: face_index=-1 for a single face, otherwise face_index=0.

type_groups.description: Backend-derived unique type groups across all Oracle faces, in land, creature, planeswalker, instant, sorcery, enchantment, artifact priority order. If none match, the sole value is other. Consume these values directly; do not derive them from translated text.

is_land.description: True if any Oracle face has Land as an English main card type. Mana curves and average mana value exclude such cards, even when the selected main face is not a land.

can_be_commander.description: Backend authority for this release: at least one individual face must contain Legendary and at least one of Creature, Planeswalker or Vehicle. Tokens from different faces are not combined. This flag does not assert full Commander-format legality. The backend revalidates eligibility during save and code parsing.

items.description: Exactly one item per requested UUID, preserving request order, including requested_printing_uuid for correlation. Multiple requests may resolve to the same final representative; the final printing UUIDs are not required to be unique.

sections.description: Always contains commander, mainboard, sideboard, maybeboard in that order, including empty sections.
Always contains commander, mainboard, sideboard, maybeboard in that order, including empty sections; input text order does not change this order.

finish.description: Collection snapshots use normal or foil. Wishlist snapshots use null.

quantity_delta.description: For add_card/remove_card snapshots this is +1/-1 respectively. For wishlist snapshots it is null. Historical snapshots are read-only.

OperationItemResponse.description: Exactly one snapshot branch is returned: card or deck. The irrelevant object is omitted, not null. A detail request fixes one action_type, so its page contains only the corresponding branch.

SetListItemResponse.description: Set hierarchy row. A normal Set exposes the first 11 dictionary languages in dictionary order, with availability flags; default_language is the first available code or null. A token Set has set_type=token, languages=[], default_language=null and navigates to /tokens without a language. Parent and depth are authoritative, not inferred from names.

field.description: Request field path using dot notation and zero-based array indexes, e.g. sections[1].cards[3].printing_uuid. JSON Pointer and one-based indexes are not used.

Error.description: Client-safe error. Field or code-line details locate validation failures. Do not expose SQL, filesystem paths, stack traces or raw internal errors. Backend business validation is authoritative.

request_id.description: Final request ID, identical to X-Request-ID; at most 128 bytes after backend normalization/replacement.

operation_id.description: Read-only positive BIGINT UNSIGNED identifier encoded as canonical decimal text. Treat it as an opaque string.
Read-only positive BIGINT UNSIGNED identifier encoded as canonical decimal text. Treat it as an opaque string.

RequestID.name: X-Request-ID
RequestID.description: Optional caller request ID. The backend trims it, replaces an empty value or a value exceeding its 128-byte limit, and returns the final ID in the response header and envelope.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: One canonical 36-character RFC 4122 UUID (versions 1-5, RFC variant). Reuse the key when retrying the same intent after a timeout or connection failure; use a new key when changing the intent or payload. Deduplication is process-local and completed records last 30 minutes. Replays return current authoritative resource state, not a byte-for-byte copy of the first response.

RequestID.description: Final request ID, present on every success and error response; equals envelope.request_id and is at most 128 bytes. maxLength is a coarse character bound; byte-length normalization is performed by the backend.

Location.description: URI of the created resource; returned for both initial creation and successful creation/copy replays.

IdempotencyDeduplicated.description: Present with the text value true when the response is the result of an idempotent replay. It is absent for an initial execution.

Http400Error.description: HTTP 400. Status-wide error codes: invalid_request, invalid_cursor, idempotency_key_required. See the operation description for applicable cases.

Http404Error.description: HTTP 404. Applicable error codes: not_found, set_not_found, card_not_found, deck_not_found.

Http409Error.description: HTTP 409. Applicable error codes: collection_underflow, idempotency_conflict.

Http422Error.description: HTTP 422. Status-wide error codes: invalid_date_range, validation_failed, card_reference_invalid, deck_parse_failed, deck_card_not_supported. See the operation description for applicable cases.
